age.description: Patient age in years at the time of encounter or measurement

sex.description: Biological sex or sex recorded in the dataset

race_ethnicity.description: Self-reported or recorded race and ethnicity category

insurance_status.description: Primary insurance type or coverage status

socioeconomic_status.description: Broad socioeconomic indicator such as income, education, or deprivation index

smoking_status.description: Current, former, never, or unknown tobacco use status

alcohol_use.description: Typical alcohol consumption or risk level

body_mass_index.description: Body mass index calculated from height and weight

diet_quality.description: Overall diet quality or nutritional risk score

comorbidity_index.description: Summary measure of baseline chronic disease burden

hypertension_history.description: Indicator for prior diagnosis or treatment of hypertension

diabetes_history.description: Indicator for prior diagnosis or treatment of diabetes

cardiovascular_disease_history.description: History of coronary artery disease, heart failure, stroke, or related cardiovascular conditions

chronic_kidney_disease_history.description: History of chronic kidney disease or reduced renal function

medication_adherence.description: Degree to which a patient follows prescribed medication regimen

baseline_blood_pressure.description: Systolic and/or diastolic blood pressure before intervention or at baseline

baseline_heart_rate.description: Heart rate measured at baseline or prior to treatment

baseline_hba1c.description: Baseline glycated hemoglobin level for glycemic control

baseline_creatinine.description: Baseline serum creatinine as a renal function marker

hospital_admission.description: Indicator for inpatient admission during the observation window

length_of_stay.description: Number of days spent in hospital for an admission

icu_admission.description: Indicator for admission to intensive care

treatment_exposure.description: Indicator or intensity measure for the main treatment or exposure

follow_up_time.description: Time from index date to event, censoring, or last contact

readmission.description: Indicator for subsequent hospital readmission within a defined window

mortality.description: All-cause death indicator within the study period

adverse_event.description: Occurrence of a clinically relevant adverse outcome or side effect

quality_of_life.description: Patient-reported health-related quality of life score
